name: Bahrain
description: Bahrain from Dilmun to the pearl trade, the Al Khalifa, British protection, oil, independence in 1971 and the uprising of 2011.

checkpoints.name: Dilmun born=~-3000 end=~-0600
checkpoints.note: Bahrain was Dilmun, a trading land between Mesopotamia and the Indus.

checkpoints.name: Pearls and the Al Khalifa
checkpoints.note: Islam came, then Portuguese and Persians. The Al Khalifa took the islands in 1783, and pearls were the wealth of the Gulf.

checkpoints.name: Oil and independence
checkpoints.note: Oil was struck in 1932. Bahrain left British protection in 1971, saw protests in 2011 and made peace with Israel in 2020.
